Your holdings: Almost all your positions are in "SELL" status and significant losses. SOXL (-86.26%), MUU (-74.08%), SPAL (-54.99%), and SMCI (-50.66%) are particularly concerning. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your stops, especially for the leveraged ETFs. Also, watch CRWD's reaction to the Zscaler news.

Bottom line: This is a critical period; focus on risk management and protecting capital.
plays: Trim CRWD: Take some profit from your 31.16% gain in CRWD, especially with the Zscaler news, to reduce overall portfolio risk.
Respect stops on leveraged ETFs: Adhere strictly to stops on SOXL (-86.26%) and MUU (-74.08%) to prevent further catastrophic losses.
Consider SQQQ LONG: Scanner shows a LONG setup (entry 54.59-54.33, stop 53.78). This is a tactical bet against the Nasdaq, aligning with current market weakness.
